items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(b) preserve coverage for assessing the cause and extent of the loss despite gradual pipe ageing. A routine assessment visit is estimated at €300 gross, below the €3,000 cap.

items.description: Indoor leak detection, technician and vehicle
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.10 and 5.2.6(a), (c) cover locating the porous sections and one vehicle charge. Allow about €420 gross for detection including technician time, plus €70 gross for travel, below the respective €1,000 and €83.30 gross caps.

items.description: Floor and skirting removal, screed preparation and disposal
items.rationale: Section 7.1.10 excludes repairs and debris removal for moisture damage from gradual leakage. This line describes whole-floor remediation, not access work specifically needed to repair the leaking pipe sections.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes provisioning for the contractor's personnel, so none of the three catering units is payable.

Section 7.1.10 excludes the drying and disinfection measures otherwise covered under 7.1.7 when the moisture resulted from gradual pipe ageing. The bundled labour and dust protection serve that excluded work.
Section 7.1.7(b) deems electricity included in the drying lump sum and bars separate reimbursement of all 2,412.1 kWh. The underlying drying is also excluded under 7.1.10.
